existing.FIT: Acquire/validate/fit/capture then new family GUID N key,insert,return. No query refit/rebinding/eviction introduced.
existing.query: Convert key in Windows,resolve own dictionary,project result/error. Retained captured reference may outlive DROP.
existing.clear: Existing LMM/MMRM CLEAR_ALL and PSM blank/ALL CLEANUP snapshot Count then Clear;race count is not removal accounting.
existing.recalc: Existing nonvolatile/non-threadsafe handle UDF registration flags unchanged. Repeated executed FIT creates distinct retained key;actual Excel recalculation graph/manual smoke NOT_RUN.

defined_policy_only.fake_verified_epochs: Pure simulation inputs,not acquired workbook/session identity.
defined_policy_only.signals: Explicit descriptor DROP/family clear/session end/workbook close/reopen/switch/repeated FIT decisions;no storage.

concurrency: Single dictionary operations retain native atomicity. Read/read and bounded get/drop/clear tested on stated paths. No blanket mutable-model thread safety or strictly serializable Count-Clear claim.
